name: lock-open
description: A visibly rotated open shackle on the shared lock body.
useCase: Distinguish an unlocked state beside explicit status text.
misuse: An open lock does not specify public visibility or sharing permissions.

16.reason: The open shackle is a semicircle that joins its vertical stem smoothly above the centered lock body.

24.reason: The rounded shackle meets its vertical stem tangentially and stays inside the drawing frame.
